scholarships.title: Scholarships for Staff and Instructors' Knowledge Advancement Program (SIKAP), Commission on Higher Education Philippines

existing.description: SIKAP is the Commission on Higher Education's principal graduate scholarship programme, funding teaching and non-teaching staff of Philippine higher education institutions to study for a Master's or Doctorate in one of ten priority disciplines within the Philippines. CHED pays tuition and other fees at actual cost and adds a monthly stipend plus a research allowance. Applicants are nominated through their employing institution, and awards are made in numbered batches against the CHED Regional Offices. The 2026 Call Cycle is open and Batch 5 closes on 5 October 2026.
eligibility: Teaching or non-teaching personnel employed full-time in a CHED-recognised higher education institution, or in a government agency or private institution with a Memorandum of Understanding with CHED

Institution must be a public or private HEI institutionally recognised by CHED and OIQAG certified, an HEI in BARMM recognised by MBHTE, or a Local University and College with CHED Institutional Recognition
Full-time employment held with no other existing employment or contract of service
Admitted and will enrol in a graduate degree programme within the term of application
Physically fit, attested by a medical certificate from a licensed government physician or the sending HEI clinic, and mentally fit as certified
No existing government-funded grant or scholarship, and no pending accountabilities from previous awards
No relative within the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity who is an existing SIKAP or HUSAY scholar or who holds direct authority to recommend inclusion
SIKAP Regular for plantilla or permanent positions; SIKAP-N for non-plantilla and non-regular personnel
benefits: Tuition and fees covered at actual cost
Monthly stipend of PHP 41,000 (Master's full-time) or PHP 54,000 (Doctorate full-time)
Part-time term subsidy of PHP 40,000 (Master's) or PHP 50,000 (Doctorate)
Research allowance of PHP 150,000 (Master's) or PHP 250,000 (Doctorate)
Both full-time and part-time study arrangements supported
coverage: Tuition and other fees at actual cost, paid directly to the delivering higher education institution
Monthly stipend of PHP 41,000 for full-time Master's study and PHP 54,000 for full-time Doctorate study
Term subsidy of PHP 40,000 (Master's) or PHP 50,000 (Doctorate) for part-time study instead of the monthly stipend
Research allowance of PHP 150,000 for Master's and PHP 250,000 for Doctorate study
requirements: Nomination by the sending higher education institution, agency or institution; there is no direct individual application to CHED
Registration of an account on the SIKAP portal at sikap.ched.gov.ph
Completion of the online application form with documentary attachments uploaded
Study programme must be offered by a CHED-recognised Delivering Higher Education Institution holding a signed Memorandum of Agreement
Programme must fall within one of the ten CHED TANYAG priority areas
documents: Medical certificate from a licensed government physician or the sending HEI clinic
Mental fitness certification from the sending HEI guidance counsellor or a licensed government psychiatrist or psychologist
Certification of no pending accountabilities or obligations from previous grants or scholarships
Proof of full-time employment with the sending institution
Admission or enrolment documentation for the graduate programme
Complete documentary attachments uploaded through the SIKAP portal
application_method: Wait for the CHED Call for Applicants for the relevant batch
Prepare documents with the sending institution, which screens and ranks applicants
Register and log in to the SIKAP Management System at sikap.ched.gov.ph
Choose the scholarship programme and batch in the Call for Applicants section
Complete the Requirements Form and upload documentary attachments
Have the sending institution submit and validate the application to the CHED Regional Office
existing.selection_notes: Screening, evaluation and approval of applications are conducted by the CHED Regional Office, applying CHED-documented eligibility criteria, slot allocation and batch timelines. Incoming Master's students who are faculty members with a salary grade of 18 or below and are included in their HEI's Manpower Development Plan are given priority.
existing.duration: Full-time or part-time study; CHED does not publish a fixed maximum duration on the programme pages read.
existing.application_period: 2026 Call Cycle, with numbered batches; Batch 5 applications close 5 October 2026 and CHED publishes further batches in the same cycle
